add_paragraph: Nia's PhD, finished in 2019, followed water quality through smallholder catchments — farmland, streams and the people who depend on both.
She now works as a Senior Consultant with the United Nations Environment Programme, turning exactly that kind of measurement into guidance that ministries can act on.
She was the first person in the lab to insist that every field dataset be published openly, and the habit stuck.
